versions.changelog:
- Initial release of zhihu-article-fetcher, a tool for fetching title and content from single Zhihu column articles (`zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/xxx`).
- Implements three-level authentication fallback: Browser Profile → File Cookie → Simulated Headers (anti-crawling bypass).
- Provides command-line usage for direct fetching, cookie-configured fetching, and file saving.
- Outputs structured JSON including metadata and article details.
- Includes troubleshooting tips for common issues and a comparison with similar skills.
